description: Land Title Settlement Department   -   Thudella, Ja- Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad.Map No. 512200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for two land parcels (Nos. 153 and 154) in Thudella village. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity details, title class, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns property ownership, land titles, and title settlement matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
